coverage_explanation: Tests the explicitly required steady green indication when neither target, or only one target, is detected, including repeated transitions between vehicle-only and pedestrian-only detection. No echo represents absence of a detected target. Simultaneous-danger activation, red flashing, alarm, danger-level values, and event-duration reporting cannot be independently specified without the missing proximity criteria, danger-level mapping, and reporting timing/units.
assumptions: Bench defaults apply to the individual LEDs: D12 and D13 are active HIGH.
A null ultrasonic distance produces no echo and therefore no detected approaching target; absence on either sensor prevents simultaneous vehicle-and-pedestrian detection.
Proximity thresholds and any approach-rate interpretation are unspecified. The tests do not require any particular finite distance to qualify as approaching.
Danger-level mapping, flash period, alarm frequency, and serial duration units/report timing are unspecified. The reference selects illustrative values without imposing them through checks.
The authoritative inventory names D2 only as an output role without defining its behavior; no behavioral expectation is imposed on D2.
